evidenceEnriched.definition: Official candidate records containing location, contact and additional operating or verification evidence. This tier is still not automatically safe for patient recommendations.

decisionReady.definition: CareRoute records that passed release-blocking identity, location, care-setting, patient-group, capability, contact and source checks.

sources.dataset: Health Center Service Delivery and Look-Alike Sites

warning: Indexed and evidence-enriched records are operational candidates, not patient recommendations. Only decision-ready records appear in the care-navigation flow.
